Who we are

One of the oldest manufacturers of PP/HDPE woven bags in India — making woven packaging since 1984, and in manufacturing since 1968.

Founded by Shri J C Agarwal with PVC hose pipes, the group began woven fabrics and sacks at 300 MT a year. Today it runs 27,000 MTPA of PP woven fabrics and bags and 6,000 MTPA of PP spunbond non-woven fabric — through Pratap Synthetics Ltd, Pratap Technoplast Pvt Ltd and Vansh Technoplast Pvt Ltd.

Granules, extrusion, weaving, lamination, printing, cutting, stitching, branding and packaging — all nine stages run in-house, on Lohia and Windmöller & Hölscher machinery.

Home / About Us The Group

In manufacturing
since 1968.

Three companies, four units, five decades — from PVC hose pipes in 1968 to 27,000 MTPA of woven packaging today.

Who we are

Pratap Group is a Kolkata-headquartered manufacturer and exporter of PP/HDPE woven fabrics and bags, block bottom bags, jumbo bags, BOPP bags and PP spunbond non-woven fabric.

The group has made PP/HDPE woven bags since 1984 and has stayed strong through undivided focus on the business, continuous technological upgradation and steady expansion. Advanced, automated machinery keeps production and quality consistent and reduces dependency on manual labour.

Its four units operate through Pratap Synthetics Ltd, Pratap Technoplast Pvt Ltd and Vansh Technoplast Pvt Ltd, across Howrah and Purba Bardhaman in West Bengal.

Our journey

1968 to today

1968

The group is founded

Established under the leadership of Shri J C Agarwal, the group comes into being with the manufacture of PVC hose pipes.

1984

Woven packaging begins

Manufacturing of HDPE/PP woven fabrics and sacks starts, with an annual capacity of 300 MT.

1992

Expansion into yarn

The group ventures into texturised POY manufacturing in Surat and expands production in Daman, Gujarat.

2006

Non-woven fabric

Entry into India's non-woven market — one of the first companies in Eastern India to set up an integrated PP spunbond non-woven unit, at 1,500 MT a year.

Today

27,000 + 6,000 MTPA

27,000 MTPA of PP woven fabrics and bags — specialising in block bottom, cement, sugar, BOPP and jumbo bags — and 6,000 MTPA of PP spunbond non-woven fabric.

Sustainability

The circular factory, expanded

  • In-house reprocessing. Production trims, edge cuts and rejects are reprocessed and fed back into extrusion instead of leaving the plant as waste.
  • Recyclable products. PP woven bags are recyclable; PP spunbond non-woven fabric is 100% recyclable.
  • Less loss in the supply chain. Laminated, heat-pasted block bottom bags deliver negligible material loss compared with traditional pillow bags.
  • Quantified reprocessing rate, effluent & emissions position, power profile

Home / Products / Block Bottom Bags Product · template shown for one line

Block Bottom
Bags

The best solution for packing cement worldwide — manufactured on a fully automated Windmöller & Hölscher line.

Overview

Block bottom PP woven bags are made through a fully automated process with the highest degree of precision. They are laminated and heat-pasted rather than stitched, which keeps material loss negligible across the entire supply chain.

Once filled, a block bottom bag takes a brick shape — stacking cleanly, storing efficiently and transporting with less damage — while carrying a premium look and high brand visibility.

Specifications

ConstructionLaminated woven PP, heat-pasted block bottom
PrintingWindmöller & Hölscher ServoTex SL — the only such machine in India
LaminationWindmöller & Hölscher EcoTex
PerforationIndexed nano perforation (NanoTex Cylco) for higher seam strength
Bag makingConverTex CL 140 & CL 170 — CL 170 the first such machine in the world
Bag sizes & GSMWidth × length × bottom, fabric GSM Awaiting spec sheet
Fill weightse.g. 25 / 50 kg Awaiting spec sheet
